segments.note: Given and verifier_detail[0] retain the record identity and Flow publication/acknowledgement ownership; clarifying that acknowledgement may be missing preserves the source's explicit unacknowledged finding rather than excluding those records.

activation.note: The common prerequisite and first firing case cover acceptance of any delivery Flow tracks with this record, including unacknowledged records. Task terms are explicitly discovery-only, acknowledgement is checked in done mode, and semantic scenario judgment remains outside the machine check. Workflow, findings and change observations honestly require new observers; task-text discovery is observable now.

audit.summary: All 46 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with acceptance conditions available to the coder and deterministic finding details retained for verification. The single acceptance obligation preserves the source exception, read-only ownership boundary and inconclusive-evidence handling; there are no shared-node moves or undeclared substantive additions.

segmentChecks.note: The record identity, Flow publication, and Flow ownership of acknowledgement survive in given and verifier_detail[0]. Saying acknowledgement may be absent is consistent with the separate done-mode unacknowledged finding.
Given/when/then retain applicability and all acceptance conditions, including exact-candidate binding and done-mode acknowledgement.
The exact-pinned Flow type, read-only consumption, and prohibition on every listed kind of parallel Bun state are explicit.
Verifier_detail[1] preserves both stale-candidate cases, including a merge record that cites no candidate record; activation also exposes the mismatch case.
The credential-free loopback allowlist and directive-cited sandbox/preview handling are retained without broadening the target policy.
Prefer, avoid, and evidence all make unreadable tracked evidence produce COULD_NOT_CHECK and forbid promotion to PASS.
Evidence[4] and activation.doesNotFire keep semantic journey validation with the checklist and behavioral-reconciliation review.
The toolkit-only N/A exception retains exact rationale, all three allowed direct-evidence examples, and the fabricated-URL prohibition.

risks: The coder-facing fields require an exact-candidate record but do not state the merge-record edge case: a merge record citing no candidate record must fail as stale-candidate. A weak implementation reading only those fields could check only provenance.commit and accept it.
The coder-facing fields refer to 'any finding' without defining the seven finding names; their detailed discriminator logic is available only in verifier_detail.

unobservable: phase: acceptance/done timing and whether Flow actually tracks the delivery with the record
finding: outputs of checkOwnerInspection over Flow state and tracked files

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the canonical obligations, exception, evidence-result semantics, and ownership boundary, so I agree with the auditor's PASS. Coder-facing guidance is generally actionable but omits the merge-record stale-candidate edge case and the detailed finding definitions, leaving some implementation ambiguity.
